players.product: gas & liquid delivery subsystems for etch/deposition tools (Lam, Applied)

quarterly_data.signal: Ichor's fiscal 2025 revenue grew 11.6% to $947.7 million on sustained demand from primary customers including Lam Research and Applied Materials, with over 90% of 2025 sales from the semiconductor capital equipment industry. Capital expenditures were $36.2 million, $17.6 million and $15.5 million in 2025, 2024 and 2023 (3.8%, 2.1% and 1.9% of sales). In 2025 Ichor began transitioning certain manufacturing activities and relocating machining assets to its expanded high-volume facilities while closing its facilities in Scotland and Korea, incurring approximately $35 million of restructuring, exit, severance and related asset impairment charges.
quarterly_data.figure: fiscal 2025 revenue $947.7 million (+11.6%); capex $36.2 million (2025, 3.8% of sales), $17.6 million (2024), $15.5 million (2023); restructuring charges approximately $35 million (2025)
